assertions.assertion: The member has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The member has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
There is concern for a potential transient cerebral ischemic attack
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The Holter study is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias
The Holter study is ordered to investigate neurological symptoms
The service is in keeping with the indication note
The diagnosis codes G45.9, R42, and Z86.73 support the clinical picture
The payer's denial under PR-204 should be reconsidered
The service is medically necessary to investigate the arrhythmia that may be causing the reported dizziness and giddiness
